Episode 37: A Bad Case of Memory Loss
Keshav throws a planter over his balcony and it hits Dilruba on his head. In shock and trauma of the hit, Dilruba has memory loss. He forgets everything and everyone, even his own name. Keshav and Prema plans to get Dil’s memory back. Watch how they do it!
